Coralee Sanford is a 35-year-old female (DOB 1989-03-07, MRN SYN-4415087) presenting with rapid-onset oligomenorrhea (cycles every 60-90 days for 10 months after prior regular 28-day cycles since menarche at age 12) and rapidly progressive hyperandrogenism and virilization over 8 months, including severe hirsutism requiring daily shaving (modified Ferriman-Gallwey score 21), temporal balding, back acne, voice deepening, increased muscle bulk, and clitoromegaly (clitoral index ~50 mm2). No exogenous androgen or supplement exposure. No Cushingoid features (BP 118/72, BMI 22.4, no moon facies, striae, or proximal muscle weakness).
